sentence: This project studies how grass species differ in phenology, growth rates and drought tolerance, to improve models of where grasses grow.
This project studies how the marine phytoplankton Synechococcus senses the ratio of blue to green light and changes its photosynthetic machinery in response.
This project studies how to combine semiconductor quantum bits with superconducting circuits to build a system for processing quantum information.
This project studies Heusler alloys to find out whether their atomic magnets can form non-collinear structures that are protected against disruption.
This project builds a power switch from gallium oxide that is driven by light signals, for use in electricity grids.
This project uses artificial intelligence and remote sensing to find bee hives and flowering habitats, then links them to crop production and economic value.
This project builds an open-source glacier model to simulate how small cirque glaciers changed in the past and will change in the future.
This project builds computer tools that combine large language models with operator learning to model changes in biological systems over time and space.
This project studies mathematical spin glasses and their applications to data science.
This project builds cybersecurity courses that include project-based learning, internships and preparation for industry certification exams.
This project studies why automated vehicles can cause traffic disorder as a group and how to give them human-like cooperative driving behavior.
This project builds models and control methods for shape-morphing structures made of connected rods that combine an artificial muscle with a shape memory polymer.
This project builds software for the re-analysis of public proteomics datasets to map protein abundances and protein interactions.
This project builds software tools that account for missing data when estimating population structure and evolutionary history from genomic data.
This project develops ways to make machine learning systems keep working when attacked and when data changes in real-world settings.
This project holds a meeting where researchers share work in probability theory, the area of mathematics that studies randomness and uncertainty.
This project builds open software that trains machine learned models of atomic interactions to simulate materials quickly and accurately.
